findingMessages.p0005-doc-misplaced-docs-lib: Three rustdoc comments in lib.rs are attached to the wrong item: slideshow_tick is documented as 'Show a transient toast at the bottom of the canvas' (a leftover from toast()); the HoverPreview struct is documented as 'Whether the settings render in black & white' (belongs to is_bw, which has no doc); and rules_view carries album_counts' whole description ('Every album's photo count for the sidebar...') while album_counts at line 1811 is undocumented. Generated docs and IDE hovers describe the wrong behaviour for these items.
findingMessages.p0005-doc-misplaced-docs-i18n: The doc for builtin_label ('A stock preset's or profile's name in the UI language; an imported or user-edited name stays exactly as its owner wrote it') is stacked on top of startup_failed_message's own doc, so startup_failed_message documents two unrelated things and builtin_label (a public translation-policy function) has no doc at all.
findingMessages.p0005-doc-locale-all-menu-order: Locale::ALL is documented as 'Every language, in menu order', but the Edit > Language menu is built from LANGUAGE_COMMANDS, whose order differs (French follows Portuguese there; in ALL it follows Russian). The doc claim is false and the two language pickers present different orders.
findingMessages.p0005-doc-misplaced-test-doc-export: The doc 'The Export dialog hands its batch to a worker thread: the UI keeps drawing frames, shows progress, and reports the result when the files are written' sits on export_dialog_keeps_its_width (a dialog-width stability test for issue #8), while the test it describes, export_dialog_runs_in_the_background, has no doc. A reader triaging a failure gets the wrong intent for both tests.
